::: {.section-heading}
## From a first question to a useful handover

Six milestones. A clear output and a conversation at every step.
:::

::: {.journey-grid}
::: {.journey-item}
### 01 · Define
Agree a question and dataset.
:::
::: {.journey-item}
### 02 · Inspect
Check one input scan.
:::
::: {.journey-item}
### 03 · Process
Pilot one segmentation.
:::
::: {.journey-item}
### 04 · Measure
Build a traceable region table.
:::
::: {.journey-item}
### 05 · Analyse
Check assumptions and figures.
:::
::: {.journey-item}
### 06 · Share
Explain, review, and hand over.
:::
